responsibility: Implements the IPA pass that lowers thread-local variables to libgcc emulated TLS when the target lacks native TLS support. It creates the __emutls control objects and initializers that describe each TLS variable, rewrites symbol-table and alias metadata to use those control vars, and transforms GIMPLE uses in function bodies into calls to BUILT_IN_EMUTLS_GET_ADDRESS plus dereferences, making TLS semantics available to LTO and whole-program compilation without backend-only late rewriting.
